title: Ship signed 0.1.5 with a local CI green gate
acceptance: version 0.1.5 builds; the setup and binaries are signed with the local self-signed certificate and verify; the setup installs per-user and leaves a desktop shortcut to the new binary; goal-verify --all prints GOAL VERIFIED at HEAD; cargo xtask ci is green; evidence records hashes, signature status, shortcut path and target.
notes: Release task. Local signing is not publicly trusted; T-0202 records that boundary.
